metadata.description: Cheena Malhotra's Copilot App plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: cm-worktree-cleanup
plugins.description: Finds obsolete git worktrees left behind by Copilot App sessions, runs on a schedule, and deletes only what you select and confirm.

plugins.name: cm-daily-standup
plugins.description: Generates a daily standup summary from your git commits, GitHub PRs/issues, and Copilot App sessions.

plugins.name: cm-my-priorities
plugins.description: Lists top-priority issues and PRs assigned or requiring your review across your repos, plus open unassigned priority issues you could pick up.
